subject: AWS listing: product positioning + procurement readiness
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing: product positioning + procurement readiness

Hi team,

Attaching a fresh pass on hero copy and three short benefit blurbs (hero_blurbs_v3.docx). The goal is a tight one-liner + two supporting bullets that play well in the AWS tile and product page.

Context: Helion Analytics is lined up for a privateoffer trial and we want the listing ready for the field by next Tuesday. Elena — including you here for a quick sanity check against latest marketplace claims guidance.

Asks:
- Kimberly: quick voice/tone pass and one-sentence alternate for the hero (we need something < 120 chars).
- Rachel: confirm procurement questions we'll need answered from Helion for the privateoffer (licenses, billing contact, SOW cadence). If you prefer, I can loop Ben (Acme procurement contact) later.
- Elena: any immediate red flags on claims/credentials or required evidence we should stage before publish?

Notes: I kept technical depth light — callouts to "high-throughput inference runtime" and "predictable per-token economics" but avoided specific model names.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: hero_blurbs_v3.docx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: product positioning + procurement readiness

Alex — good start. Quick notes inline and an alternate hero: "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference at cloud scale" (82 chars).

My edits:
- Hero: tighten to the core benefit (latency + cost predictability). Avoid the word "runtime" in the hero; save that for the body.
- Bullets: switch one bullet to customer outcomes ("reduced per-request cost") and one to platform controls ("dedicated capacity with SLA").
- Avoiding any percentages or absolute token pricing here — those are procurement/offer details.

Also: add a small trust callout block for SOC 2 + VPC/private deploy options. Elena — if AWS requires specific wording for security claims on the marketplace tile, flag it and we will adjust.

If this works, I can produce a final copy for Alex to attach to the offer submission.

K

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@amazon.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: product positioning + procurement readiness

Thanks for the heads up — happy to review. Quick guidance from Marketplace compliance team:

- Claims: keep security statements fact-based (e.g., "SOC 2 Type II audited") and avoid comparative language ("faster than X").
- Evidence: we will request the SOC 2 cert and a short architecture diagram for private/VPC options during the preflight. A public link to an evidence PDF is fine.
- Tile copy: 80–100 char hero works best. Avoid proprietary model names and avoid percent savings claims in the short bullets.

I've shared the preflight checklist in the seller portal — link below. I'll also schedule a brief call early next week if you want to walk through the required attestations.

Seller portal: https://sellercentral.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/offer/submit/12345

Elena

Elena Ruiz
AWS Marketplace Partner Development
elena.ruiz@amazon.com
[Related link: marketplace preflight checklist]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: product positioning + procurement readiness

Looping in procurement notes for Helion trial. I captured the minimum fields we need from the buyer to complete a privateoffer (procurement_checklist.xlsx attached):

- Legal entity & billing address
- Purchase order / SOW owner + email
- Contract term (trial length) and renewal opt-in
- Expected monthly commit (extent needed for SKU mapping)
- Security evidence acceptance (link to SOC 2 + data retention policy)
- KMS/HSM requirements (yes/no)

On pricing: for the privateoffer we should avoid public per-token numbers in the listing. Use "contact us" CTA for private pricing cases. If Helion confirms a monthly commit I'll ask finance to prepare the SKU mapping.

Next steps I propose:
1) Alex finalize copy based on Kimberly's hero.
2) I will send the procurement file to Helion's PO contact and request answers (I can include Ben Jacobs if appropriate).
3) Attach SOC 2 PDF to the seller portal preflight by Monday.

Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@amazon.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: product positioning + procurement readiness

Thanks everyone — good progress. Final decisions below: 

- Hero (final): "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference at cloud scale"
- Bullets (final):
  • "Reduce per-request cost with intelligent batching and KV caching"
  • "Dedicated capacity options with SLA-backed latency targets"
- Trust callout: "SOC 2 Type II audited; VPC and on-prem deployment options"

Action items:
- Kimberly: please produce the final hero + bullets doc and save as hero_blurbs_final.docx.
- Rachel: send procurement_checklist.xlsx to Helion (cc Ben) and request PO contact + SOC 2 PDF by EOD Tuesday.
- Elena: once we upload SOC 2 and the architecture diagram, please run preflight. If there are edits, we'll act quickly.

If no objections by EOD today I'll proceed to submit the offer draft in the seller portal and mark the listing as "draft - pending evidence."

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
